QuestInfo.name: [Ren] Specter of the Past
QuestInfo.0: The guild master sent word asking you to come to Vallora. What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1: Meet with Karman at the Traveler's Guild.
QuestInfo.2: The guild master told you a rumor about how the High Flora priest who tried to hurt you and Saya turned into a monster on his quest for power.
